item.text:
Dear Residents,

Hallway painting will begin on Tuesday, and workers will be in the building while the work is underway. Please move all bikes, boxes, and other belongings out of the hallways by Monday night so the crew can work safely and access the areas being painted.

We expect the painting to be finished by Thursday, but this timing is not guaranteed, as weather conditions may affect drying times.

Thank you for your help, patience, and cooperation!
